newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Dongbu, Han Nong notify SSB of merger.
newsitem.headline: Dongbu, Han Nong notify SSB of merger.

text.p: Dongbu Chemical Co and Han Nong Corp, affiliates of South Korea's Dongbu Group, have notified the Securities Supervisory Board (SSB) of their plan to merge as of March 1, 1997, the stock watch body said on Monday.
Dongbu and Han Nong plan to merge their shares on a 0.3-for-one basis, respectively, the SSB said in a statement.
Shareholders who wish to sell shares back to the companies may do so between January 20 and February 15, at a price of 34,571 won per Han Nong share and 9,010 won for the Dongbu shares, it said.

The merged company is expected to post a turnover of 600 billion won in 1997 with assets totalling 650 billion, the Dongbu Group had earlier said. Its sales are seen increasing to 2.3 trillion won by the year 2001.
Dongbu is expected to record a turnover of 350 billion won this year and Han Nong 200 billion, the group said.
Dongbu, a chemical producer, has a paid-in capital of 36.7 billion won and Han Nong, a leading manufacturer of agricultural products, 8.7 billion won.
